title: Journey launch actions and the notification registry have tests
detail: The launch surface (schedule a send, schedule the series, build the funnel, message enrollees) re-checks authorization and tier on every call, and nothing pinned that. The notification registry had its first rows pinned by name and no whole-catalog invariants. Tests added for both. The product gaps found beside them stay open as follow-ups: Journeys email and Dispatch to a cohort are offered as disabled chips, and the in-app channel is not on the outbox yet.

verify.note: Exits 0 once both test files exist.
